messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a 'sidecar' mode for console analytics: ephemeral query flags attached to a route view so PMs can toggle telemetry/rollout probes without touching saved queries. Thoughts?
kevin: do you mean flags that only affect telemetry sampling & routing hints, not the saved query payload itself?
sanjay: yep, +1 for keeping saved queries immutable. main concern: how do we surface quota impact for ephemeral flags?
maria: exactly. idea: flags = lightweight metadata blob, UI toggles store them on the route session and optionally push a short-lived annotation to telemetry. NOT a full saved query. example payload: ```{"flag":"enable_kv_cache_probe","ttl":3600,"sample_rate":0.1}```
kevin: API-wise we need a clear contract: POST /routes/:id/flags -> returns flag_id, TTL, and estimated token cost delta. UI can show cost preview.
aria-bot: RFC draft: https://redwood.internal/specs/analytics-sidecar (wip) :page_facing_up:
olivia: UX note — users kept losing ephemeral toggles when navigating away. We should persist flags to session/localstorage and show a small banner: "ephemeral flag active" with undo.
sanjay: implementation note: routing layer must honor flag-based routing hints but obey "+fallback" policy when capacity or quota prevents preferred model. Also record flag provenance in traces.
maria: agreed. open Q: should flags be per-route-per-model or route-global? my leaning: per-route-per-model to allow A/B across models.
kevin: per-model is more flexible but explodes UI complexity. Suggest default to per-route, advanced toggle for per-model.
olivia: from usability testing — most PMs want per-model control when testing new quantized variants.
maria: good call. I'll update prototype to support per-model but hide it behind "Advanced".
sanjay: for quotas: add a soft-warning when flag sample_rate * expected_traffic > quota_threshold. Also log a telemetry event with flag_id and sample_rate.
kevin: developer API: include a preflight endpoint POST /routes/:id/flags/preflight that returns cost estimate and any quota blockers.
maria: will wire preflight + cost preview in the console. Also adding a lightweight audit trail for 24h.
aria-bot: deploy-bot: staging rollout for analytics-sidecar feature on 1823450300 — monitor for errors.
olivia: UX follow-up: add a tiny inline tooltip explaining "ephemeral vs saved" and a link to the RFC.
maria: next steps: I'll push updated mockups + API contract by EOD. @kevin @sanjay can you review the preflight schema?
kevin: will review after stand.
sanjay: same, ping me on the PR. :thumbsup:
